Jack Heart (2026-10-27): this must also address indexing. Queries over an eval run should be fast, and we should not waste computation rebuilding indexes over and over. Add author-declared rollups: additive aggregates computed once per block at seal into ROLLUP.parquet, then summed incrementally by statsdb, never recomputed from raw rows. Sort each block's tables by (match, game) with small row groups. See the newest Decisions entry in scratch/jack-heart-eb70f8-keep-each-eval.md. This is in scope for the PR now being prepared.
